newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germans charged over attack on black Britons.
newsitem.headline: Germans charged over attack on black Britons.

text.p: Two German men were charged on Thursday in connection with an attack on three black British building workers in Mahlow near Berlin which left one of the workers paralysed.

Prosecutors in the city of Potsdam believe the men, aged 17 and 24, followed the Britons' car in their own vehicle after an incident outside Mahlow railway station last June in which the older man called one of Britons a "nigger".
The older man, a fitter, was identified only as Mario P. The other, a legal juvenile, was not named.
The men pulled alongside the Britons and the younger man allegedly hurled a stone through the rear side window of their car.
The car swerved, hit another car and rolled over several times, the prosecutors' statement said.
The 24-year-old driver suffered serious injuries and was left paralysed from the neck down. His two companions were injured less seriously.
The accused are charged with grievous bodily harm, dangerous interference in traffic, offensive behaviour and causing material damage.
